correctness.rationale: Brownian killed-interval BVP gives A,B; competing exponential reset gives C. Independent cycles prove Pr(N=n,M<m)=A C^n. Explicit exact expansions yield the Gumbel, size-biased geometric, and low-rate Bernoulli limits. The discrete total-variation claim follows from normalized limiting masses; the low-rate remainder is controlled by Pr(N>=2)=q^2. Reproducible finite checks pass but are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The stopped path maximum measures excursion risk whereas N measures resets consumed. Their exact coupling proves stochastic growth of risk with reset count, an explicit logarithmic high-budget Gumbel center, a rare-event size-bias mechanism, and a nonuniform low-rate Bernoulli crossover. These directly address motivated cost/risk questions not answered by either known marginal law.
